verdict.rationale: a-Shell's own `pickFolder` command opens directories inside other apps' sandboxes (built on iOS 13 file sharing). Once a folder is selected, 'you can do pretty much anything you want here', such as running Python or TeX and sending results to a third app. Picked folders are bookmarked so you can return to them without picking again. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of repository/git workflows (e.g. a git command) on those external folders, independent or hands-on corroboration.
